blind.description: A vertical square-section timber post or column with bevelled edges. Near the top, a separated collar section features four rounded wooden pegs or dowels protruding horizontally from each face. The model is finished with a stylized brown wood texture showing grain, knots, and tree rings on the flat top face.
blind.from_above: A square with chamfered corners and four small pegs projecting outward from the center of each side, featuring painted concentric tree rings in the center of the top face.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6.5 to 7 feet tall (noticeably taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 1.2 to 1.5 feet wide across the pegs.

notes: four horizontal pegs near the top widen the overall footprint compared to the post shaft
